title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
abstract: Long-Context Transformer Models (LCTMs) are vital for real-world applications but suffer high computational costs due to attention's quadratic complexity. Block-sparse attention mitigates this by focusing computation on critical regions, yet existing methods struggle with balancing accuracy and efficiency due to costly block importance measurements. In this paper, we introduce XAttention, a plug-and-play framework that dramatically accelerates long-context inference in Transformers models using sparse attention. XAttention's key innovation is the insight that the sum of antidiagonal values (i.e., from the lower-left to upper-right) in the attention matrix provides a powerful proxy for block importance. This allows for precise identification and pruning of non-essential blocks, resulting in high sparsity and dramatically accelerated inference. Across comprehensive evaluations on demanding long-context benchmarks—including RULER and LongBench for language, VideoMME for video understanding, and VBench for video generation—XAttention achieves accuracy comparable to full attention while delivering substantial computational gains. We demonstrate up to 13.5× acceleration in attention computation. These results underscore XAttention's ability to unlock the practical potential of block sparse attention, paving the way for scalable and efficient deployment of LCTMs in real-world applications.

innovative_points.name: Antidiagonal Scoring Mechanism
innovative_points.description: Revolutionary insight that antidiagonal sums in attention blocks serve as powerful proxies for block importance, replacing complex pooling or search algorithms
innovative_points.technical_details: Within each B×B block, sums values along strided antidiagonals (stride S) to efficiently detect both vertical and slash attention patterns
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Reduces pattern selection time from O(L²) to O(L²/S²), achieving 24.9× speedup vs MInference and 5.9× vs FlexPrefill
innovative_points.matrix_representation: Pattern selection: [L/S, L/S, B²/S²] vs baseline [L, L, 1]

innovative_points.name: Dynamic Threshold Block Selection
innovative_points.description: Adaptive threshold-based block selection that automatically identifies the minimal set of important blocks based on cumulative probability
innovative_points.technical_details: Uses softmax-normalized antidiagonal scores with greedy selection to find minimal block set exceeding threshold τ
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Achieves 6-55% attention density depending on context length, enabling 13.5× attention speedup at 256K tokens
innovative_points.matrix_representation: Sparse attention: [L, d, L×density] where density ∈ [0.06, 0.55]

innovative_points.name: Per-Head Minimum Threshold Prediction
innovative_points.description: Dynamic programming approach to optimize threshold τ for each attention head individually, maximizing accuracy-efficiency trade-off
innovative_points.technical_details: D[h][m] = max(D[h-1][m], P(h,m)) with 10% threshold reduction per step, M=1000 max adjustments
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Improves accuracy by 3.51 points while reducing density by 5.16% compared to fixed threshold
innovative_points.matrix_representation: No additional computation - threshold optimization is pre-computed

innovative_points.name: Plug-and-Play Architecture
innovative_points.description: Training-free framework that requires no model retraining or architectural modifications
innovative_points.technical_details: Compatible with both causal and non-causal attention, works with existing pre-trained models
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Zero training cost, immediate deployment benefit
innovative_points.matrix_representation: Same computational graph as baseline, only mask changes

innovative_points.name: Multimodal Adaptation
innovative_points.description: Successful extension to video understanding and generation tasks beyond language modeling
innovative_points.technical_details: Includes warmup strategy for diffusion models (5 full-attention steps before sparse computation)
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Maintains quality in video generation: PSNR > 23.5, SSIM > 0.82 with 50-65% sparsity
innovative_points.matrix_representation: Video frames: [F×H×W, d, F×H×W×density] where F=frames, H×W=spatial resolution

improvements_suggested.improvement: Adaptive block sizing based on content complexity
improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Use hierarchical block sizes (e.g., 4×4, 8×8, 16×16) with dynamic selection based on local attention variance
improvements_suggested.runtime_impact: Additional cost: [L, L, log(B)] for block size selection, but better pattern capture

improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Learn stride S based on input statistics (sequence length, domain, attention entropy)
improvements_suggested.runtime_impact: Small overhead: [batch, 1, 1] neural network prediction, amortized over sequence

improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Extend antidiagonal concept to include diagonal, horizontal, and local patterns with learned weights
improvements_suggested.runtime_impact: Additional patterns: [L/S, L/S, k×B²/S²] where k=number of patterns (k≤4)
improvements_suggested.expected_benefit: Better pattern coverage, 3-5% accuracy improvement on diverse tasks

improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Combine with RingAttention for distributed sparse computation with minimal communication
improvements_suggested.runtime_impact: Communication: [L/√P, d, L/√P] where P=number of GPUs
improvements_suggested.expected_benefit: Linear scaling to extremely long sequences (1M+ tokens)

improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Train small meta-model to predict optimal thresholds from input embeddings
improvements_suggested.runtime_impact: Meta-model: [batch, d, H] where H=number of heads, negligible overhead

improvements_suggested.limitation: No consideration of attention head specialization
improvements_suggested.technical_approach: Apply different sparsity strategies based on head type (local, global, sink, retrieval)
improvements_suggested.expected_benefit: 2-4% accuracy improvement by preserving critical head patterns

key_achievements.accuracy_maintenance: Comparable to full attention across benchmarks
key_achievements.multimodal_success: Effective on language, video understanding, and generation
